title: Lightly Flaky Moroccan Yukon Gold Potatoes Tagine
description: A flavorful one-pot Moroccan dish featuring yukon gold potatoes, this recipe combines herbal notes with a flaky texture, all while being keto-friendly. It is cooked to perfection in an iron teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium heat, then add the olive oil to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced onion to the teppan and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the teppan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the dashi extract, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the teppan, stirring to combine.
Add the sliced Yukon Gold potatoes to the teppan, stirring to coat the potatoes with the spice mixture.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the teppan, and cook for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and lightly flaky.
Remove the teppan from the heat and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the potatoes hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
